statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-116587 is a denial of service from crafted RSA parameters in a parsed JWK in go-jose v3 (no v3 fix; fixed in v4 4.1.6). Vault's own v3 users (wrapping, audit, PKI ACME JWS, OIDC provider, agent test helper) are ported to v4 from upstream main 644e857134 + 17daa72acd, and vault-plugin-auth-jwt v0.27.3 with cap v0.15.0 drop the plugin's v3. The one importer left is github.com/okta/okta-sdk-golang/v5/okta (Okta auth method), which uses v3 only to SIGN: createKeySigner and createClientAssertion (client.go:631-682) and the DPoP proof (client.go:1662-1663) build a jose.Signer and CompactSerialize a JWT. It never parses a JWK, parses a JOSE object or decrypts a JWE, which is where the flaw lives. The recipe fails the build if any package other than okta-sdk-golang/v5/okta imports v3 (go list -deps). Checked 2026-11-11 against vault 2.0.4 and 2.1.2 with okta-sdk-golang/v5 v5.0.2.
